newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 9.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ten percent increase expected this year in number of Saudis going to Canada. Around 12,000 Saudis visited Canada last year.
- Saudi Arabia offers 6,000 jobs for pilgrimage services.
- The closure of six international schools in the industrial city of Jubail worries parents and top company executives.
- Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan ends Paris visit.
- Saudi Arabia to set up an agricultural marketing company in three months with a 500 million riyal capital.
- Saudi industry minister says the kingdom's industrial products competing in the world market. Value of Saudi industrial manufacturing grew to $8 billion in 1995 from $607 million in 1985.
- Eastern Province Cement Company to pay a 35 riyal dividend to shareholders for 1996.
